argv: import pathlib,json; s=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::',1)[1]; p=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/s.lstrip('/'); m=(p/'memory.max').read_text().strip(); n=(p/'pids.max').read_text().strip(); cpu=(p/'cpu.max').read_text().split(); assert m=='4294967296' and n=='128' and cpu[0]!='max' and int(cpu[0])/int(cpu[1])==2; print(json.dumps({'cgroup':s,'memory_max':m,'pids_max':n,'cpu_max':cpu,'kernel_limits_match':True}))
